# Context and Perception {#sec-context-perception}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How does an agent construct a trustworthy working view from incomplete and potentially hostile observations?_

## Planned Coverage

- Observation pipelines and environment adapters
- Context selection under bounded attention and latency
- Freshness, relevance, provenance, and trust labels
- Prompt injection and indirect instruction as data-integrity failures
- Context compression, loss, and conflict resolution

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to design a context pipeline that distinguishes evidence, instructions, derived state, and untrusted content.
